dedupe_keys.name: european hydrogen backbone and the hydrogen infrastructure map europe entsog gie and partners

description: The European Hydrogen Backbone (EHB) initiative is a group of thirty-three European gas infrastructure operators, with its secretariat run by Gas Infrastructure Europe since Guidehouse's role ended in 2024. Its website, read on 2026-09-26, publishes reports since April 2021 (a 21-country vision), April 2022 (28 countries), the five hydrogen supply corridors of May 2022, implementation roadmaps and a December 2024 report on resilience and competitiveness. The infrastructure pathway to 2040 shows the vision of 32 network operators based on national analyses of existing gas infrastructure and future markets. Maps are now served by the Hydrogen Infrastructure Map, a joint initiative of ENTSOG, GIE, Eurogas, CEDEC, GD4S and GEODE that gathers projects of gas transmission, distribution, storage and LNG operators and third-party promoters to 2050 in six categories: transmission (new or converted), distribution, terminals and ports, demand and production, and storage by type (salt cavern, aquifer, depleted field and others). Viewing is free; references and pictures may be reused with proper reference to ehb.eu. Caveats: the map is interactive with no bulk download on the pages read, and routes and dates may shift. Simulation uses are future hydrogen network topology for capacity planning and network flow studies. Related records: data-entsog-tyndp-gas-hydrogen-projects covers the formal project list.
